evidence.claim: A real LoRA run, checkpoint selection, PyTorch inference, and merged-weight vLLM inference are documented.

corpus_audit.boundary: The historical run did not preserve a strict grouped corpus-audit artifact.

evidence.claim: A real LoRA run completed and selected epoch 12 by cross-validation loss.

training.boundary: Real multi-rank early-stop behavior remains unverified.

evidence.claim: The selected LoRA checkpoint was preserved.
New single-process torch_ddp runs can publish content-bound epoch continuation packages with optimizer, scheduler, scaler, RNG, progress, and CV monitor state.

checkpoint_save.boundary: Historical checkpoint preservation does not validate the new resume contract or establish merged-runtime equivalence.

evidence.claim: The selected adapter loaded in the recorded PyTorch runtime.

fresh_process_reload.boundary: The merged vLLM export completed a matched three-seed comparison, but both runtimes failed content faithfulness and the derived export did not establish equivalence.

evidence.claim: Fifteen rows were valid while six rows assigned to emotion-control categories returned implausible 0.04-second audio; the historical runner did not submit their instructions.
The corrected runner routes instructed rows through inference_instruct2 and records the control route.

A preregistered same-conditioning long-form pair completed in fresh processes, but both candidates produced semantically corrupted content and the epoch-12 adapter had materially worse requested-text WER.
The corrected inference_instruct2 route completed six Base and six adapter rows, but all 12 failed requested-text WER and exact instruction-exclusive overlap was found post hoc in eight rows.

The epoch-12 PyTorch adapter and derived merged vLLM export completed three matched seeds, but both failed every content-faithfulness row and vLLM had higher mean WER, more repetition, longer output, and higher peak GPU allocation.
Adapter PyTorch and merged-in-memory PyTorch emitted byte-identical audio for three seeds, while merged vLLM diverged and every condition failed content faithfulness.

A 45-row multi-prompt study reproduced two upstream vLLM runs byte for byte, localized a request-seed association to structured long-form rows, found a broad top-p effect including one near-silent failure, and rejected every condition on content faithfulness.

held_out_inference.boundary: The negative results are bounded to the selected checkpoint, frozen prompts and seeds, retained reference, explicit request profiles, and recorded PyTorch and vLLM environments. The blind emotion-obedience and sampling-profile packs remain unrated.

evidence.claim: The frozen suite exposed six masked background-thread failures and later audit showed that the requested instructions had been ignored.
The complete nine-metric contract passed, but requested-text ASR exposed high WER and repetition for both candidates; the post-hoc exact overlap diagnostic additionally flagged Base, not epoch 12.
The corrected route produced complete objective evidence, universal WER failures, and post-hoc instruction-overlap attribution; it does not prove emotion obedience or adaptation benefit.

The matched runtime suite bound exact PyTorch artifacts and a derived vLLM export, completed objective, prosody, content, audio-identity, and blind-pack artifacts, and rejected a runtime-equivalence or quality promotion.
The preregistered three-way suite localized the divergence downstream of the in-memory merge for this slice, recorded vLLM rerun waveform drift, and retained an unrated nine-sample blind pack.

The 45-row suite bound request profiles, exact audio identity, objective and content metrics, prosody, artifact verification, and a counterbalanced blind pack while retaining one invalid near-silent output.

evaluation.boundary: Corrected route and request-profile execution are validated for focused slices, but content fidelity is negative and no human ratings support emotion-obedience or perceptual claims.

evidence.claim: The PyTorch lifecycle publishes a content-addressed package through a path, device, and inode-bound external retention contract.

packaging.boundary: Dependency-free tests establish retention mechanics only. No real package, backup, restore, or rights approval is recorded. The matched PyTorch-versus-vLLM report is negative and does not establish equivalence.

evidence.claim: The recorded full-SFT path overfit in the tested single-speaker run and is not promoted by this companion.
The explicit unchanged Base mode completed the frozen long-form route in a fresh process, but its semantically corrupted output is not a quality success.
Base completed six corrected inference_instruct2 rows in a clean fresh process, but all failed requested-text WER and five had post-hoc exact instruction overlap.

runtimes.notes: Real-model corrected-route execution is validated for two prompts and three seeds. Quality conformance is negative.

evidence.claim: The LoRA inference tool generated valid checkpoint samples through the pinned PyTorch path.
The epoch-12 adapter completed a clean fresh-process long-form run but was materially worse than Base on requested-text WER.
The epoch-12 adapter completed six corrected inference_instruct2 rows in a clean fresh process, but all failed requested-text WER and three had post-hoc exact instruction overlap.
Merged-in-memory PyTorch emitted byte-identical audio to adapter PyTorch for three seeds, but both failed every content-faithfulness row.

runtimes.notes: The route is executed and diagnostically useful. Content conformance remains negative, and no persistent post-merge artifact binding exists.

evidence.claim: The companion can persist merged LLM state as content-bound safetensors and reload it into the pretrained PyTorch architecture in a separate process.

A real persisted epoch-12 safetensors model reloaded in a fresh PyTorch process emitted byte-identical audio to adapter and in-memory merged PyTorch for three seeds, but every content-faithfulness row failed.
The persisted model completed nine local-context, pronunciation, and structured-long-form rows, but all failed WER and five had repetition excess.

runtimes.notes: The real export and fresh-process reload are executed and diagnostically useful. Serialization and reload preserved the tested PyTorch outputs, but content conformance remains negative.

evidence.claim: A merged-weight export and vLLM 0.15.1 inference were validated end to end on the recorded environment.
The derived export completed three matched seeds faster than PyTorch, but failed every content row, had higher mean WER and repetition, and did not establish equivalence.
The three-way run reproduced vLLM divergence after adapter and merged PyTorch emitted identical WAVs; a rerun of the same export also changed waveform hashes despite identical durations.

The four-way run cleared persisted serialization and fresh-process PyTorch reload in the tested slice. vLLM still diverged and failed all content rows, while its WAV hashes matched the immediately preceding run.

Two upstream runs reproduced nine WAVs byte for byte. Request seeding changed only structured-long-form rows, top-p 0.8 changed all rows and caused one near-silent output, and every profile failed content faithfulness.

The serial diagnostic runner is designed to record vLLM 0.15.1 request ordinals, input-batch sampling state, request-local generator seeds when present, output token counts, and token hashes without retaining token content. Its internal capture contract fails closed and requires a new live smoke after correction.

The first two-row receipt smoke retained complete but universally invalid coverage because the proposed sampling-state hook was not on the live engine path. Inspection localized request registration to GPUInputBatch and showed that unseeded requests use the process-global generator.

runtimes.notes: The pinned upstream integration does not pass a per-request LoRA adapter to vLLM.

blockers: The corrected emotion-route blind listening ratings are incomplete.
The 45-file sampling-profile blind pack remains unrated and cannot override universal content failure.

The published sampling-profile study predates request-level receipts, and the first receipt smoke falsified its hook. Text length and frontend request count remain confounded until corrected instrumentation passes a new smoke and split-boundary experiment.

rights.code: The companion tools are Apache-2.0. CosyVoice uses separate upstream community terms.
rights.weights: Pin and review the upstream model-weight terms separately from this repository's code license.
rights.dataset: Record dataset provenance, permitted use, and speaker consent before training.
rights.generated_output: Review the model and dataset terms for the intended generated-output use.

known_gaps: Perceptual ranking of the selected checkpoint remains pending.

The first explicit same-conditioning long-form run produced semantically corrupted content for both Base and epoch 12. The post-hoc evaluator 0.37 diagnostics flagged high WER and repetition for both, plus exact retained-reference overlap for Base only; preregister the thresholds and replicate across frozen seeds.

The corrected inference_instruct2 run produced valid WAVs but universal requested-text WER failure and frequent post-hoc exact instruction overlap; test any frontend or instruction rewrite under a new frozen plan.
The early-stop helper passed a two-rank control smoke, but a real multi-rank production training run remains unverified.
Guarded single-process epoch continuation has dependency-free contract coverage but no real interrupted GPU comparison.
DeepSpeed, multi-rank, and multi-worker guarded continuation are rejected until rank-local and worker state plus collective publication are represented.
Run a real PyTorch lifecycle package through managed backup and verified restore after completing model, dataset, speaker, and generated-output rights review.

The 45-row sampling-profile study reproduced unchanged upstream vLLM audio, localized request-seed differences to structured long-form rows, and found a broad top-p effect with one near-silent failure, but every condition failed content faithfulness. The first receipt smoke falsified its internal hook and moved capture to the live GPUInputBatch path. Pass a newly preregistered receipt smoke before running a split-boundary follow-up or attributing the effect to request count.
